LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_MainBattle.label: main battle specification
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_MainBattle.description:
The design and production technology behind the total-war specification mechs and related equipment that the colonial fleets field against planet-scale hostile organizations and harmful entities. The manufacturing process of these mechs has been drastically simplified so that they serve better as high-performance weapons, produced and expended without pause over the course of a total war. Their performance, however, does not come from nowhere.
After the main battle specification leak on colonial world ████, colonial fleets across sector ████ observed similar technology reaching interstellar pirates and spacefaring military regimes through arms dealers. The technology recovery programs each fleet carried out after the incident proved effective, and the main battle specification was sealed again after ████.

To prevent such an incident from happening again, however, approved by ████ and ██, the main battle specification and its related technologies are designated class II sealed technology. Provision of such technology to developing worlds is prohibited, and outside emergency war mobilization, standing ground-force deployments are to avoid employing it in any military operation.
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_MainBattle.discoveredLette: Sealed file II: main battle specification

Using the data they have gathered, researchers have finished decoding the sealed technology: the production patterns of the mechs the fleets build to be expended in total war.

The gravekeeper can now be gestated at a large automatroid constructor, either in its standard pattern or with a Stugna missile rack on its shoulder. Most of its parts are shared with the mobile dragoon.

The fleets sealed this file again after it leaked to pirates and military regimes, and they will move against anyone who holds it now.
